content.short: Sync AI provides AI-powered infrastructure for DePIN and automated governance participation on Cardano.
content.description: Sync AI is an infrastructure project on Cardano that leverages artificial intelligence to enhance Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks (DePIN) and ecosystem governance. The platform features specialized AI agents that act as personal assistants, summarizing proposals for Project Catalyst and providing data-driven voting advice. Sync AI also includes a Web3-native chat interface for direct communication between users and decentralized applications. By reducing friction in information exchange, Sync AI empowers the community to participate in on-chain decision-making.
content.meta: Sync AI offers AI-powered agents for Cardano governance, Catalyst summaries, and DePIN management. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
